scenes.text: You probably won't believe this wild medical fact, but your own body is currently producing an ultra-potent natural painkiller that is actually six times stronger than morphine.
It is a hidden chemical compound called opiorphin, and it is the exact reason why your immediate, biological instinct has always been to lick a painful wound.

Fascinated researchers recently discovered that this tiny salivary molecule blocks your nervous system from destroying its own natural defenses, completely stopping pain without any dangerous side effects.

This means you are walking around with a highly valuable, pharmaceutical-grade wonder drug inside your mouth every single second of the day. If you had to choose, would you rather keep this miraculous healing spit or trade it for actual x-ray vision? Tell me your choice in the comments!
